text: {"summary":"Verified and finalized the aomi-app-ux-tool-maker curation of apps/geckoterminal (price-oracle/DEX-analytics archetype, public API, no auth). Deliberately dropped endpoints: /networks/{network}/tokens/multi (redundant with batch pricing), /networks/{network}/pools/{pool_address}/info (overlaps token info), /tokens/info_recently_updated (global feed, no user story). Tools hydrate JSON:API relationships via include=base_token,quote_token,dex so the LLM sees symbols/DEX names instead of bare IDs; generated client types are trimmed of UI-only fields (no image_url/logoURI). PREAMBLE is domain-specific (~30 lines: role, capabilities per tool, network-slug/string-numeric/rate-limit conventions, tool-chaining workflow guidance, USD formatting rules) and reconciled against the shipped tool list. Verification: cargo build clean (cdylib libgeckoterminal.dylib produced), coverage cross-check of all 20 spec operations done, and a live API smoke against https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2 confirmed the base URL, JSON:API shape, and string-encoded numerics match tool assumptions. test.json is seeded with the happy-path story: 'Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one: its current price, 24h volume and liquidity, and any recent trades over $10k.'
